description: This file defines a hash map and hash set implementation using a flat hash map structure with various hash policies and internal data structures. It includes class templates for flat_hash_map and flat_hash_set, as well as hash policies like power_of_two_hash_policy and fibonacci_hash_policy, and internal data structures for efficient hash table management.

classes.name: flat_hash_map
classes.description: A hash map implementation based on a flat hash table with customizable hash and equality policies.

classes.name: flat_hash_set
classes.description: A hash set implementation based on a flat hash table with customizable hash and equality policies.

classes.name: power_of_two_hash_policy
classes.description: Hash policy that uses bitwise AND for index calculation, suitable for power-of-two sized tables.

classes.name: fibonacci_hash_policy
classes.description: Hash policy that uses multiplication with a large constant and bit shifting for index calculation, based on Fibonacci hashing.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access or insert element by key in flat_hash_map.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Access element by key with bounds checking in flat_hash_map.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Insert element into hash map or set with perfect forwarding.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Insert or assign element in hash map.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Remove element(s) by iterator or key.

methods.name: rehash
methods.description: Resize hash table to at least the specified number of buckets.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Pre-allocate space for a number of elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Check if hash table is empty.
